youtube_description:
Taking the train from Jakarta to Bogor is easy peasy, there are regular commuter trains running throughout the day and the ticket is cheap! In this video I will show you how to buy your ticket and what the train journey is like, so come along with me to Bogor!

You might be asking "But why would you want to take a commuter train from Jakarta to Bogor in the first place?" Well 2 good reasons are that Bogor is a bit cooler than Jakarta but more importantly it has some beautiful botanical gardens making it well worth a day trip if you have a day to kill in Jakarta. 

If you've read this far then you are probably interested in finding out more, so go and look for my next video in my Java Indonesia series which is all about the Bogor Botanical gardens.

This video is part of my Java Indonesia Travel Video Series, so if you want to see more then check out more Java Travel videos in the link below:
http://bit.ly/2ksD7cL
